comments.author: apostacy
comments.story: Reasons to Quit Twitter and Facebook and Switch to Mastodon
comments.why: Example of sensationalist media coverage of internet hackers
comments.text: The term I would use is: 4chan users engaged in Live Action Role Playing. They were trying to spook you, and they did, apparently. The most they could muster from the entire world is < 200. I remember when the media tried telling us about how "Anonymous" were "hackers on steroids" who treated things like a "real life video game".[1] Yes, there are some creeps out there. But they are not a serious threat. [1]: [VIDEO]
